name: spawn_process
description: Spawn a fire-and-forget background process in the Agent OS. Returns the PID immediately and does NOT return the process's result — the scheduler runs it autonomously; you observe it only via IPC (read_mailbox / wait_process) or side effects. Use for long-running background processes, two-way IPC collaboration, or work whose output you do not need back. If you need the result returned, use task_spawn instead.

goal.description: The specific goal or task for the sub-process to accomplish.

quota_turns.description: Maximum tool-calling turns per scheduler run before the process yields. Default 10.

capabilities.description: Optional exact capability set for the child process. Omitted means inherit the parent capabilities.

signal.description: Allow signaling child or descendant processes.

allowed_tools.description: Additional tool names allowed alongside the baseline tool set. Omitted inherits the parent's allowlist; an empty array leaves tool access unrestricted.
